spans.s:
mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Flown up, flying up.
n. (-नं)
1 Flying as a bird.
2 Flying up, soaring.
E.
उद् up, and डी to fly, क्त aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Flying, soaring, who flies or soars.
E.
उत् up, डी to fly, शानच् aff.

m. (-शः)
1 A work so called, containing charms and incantations.
2 A name of ŚIVA.
E.
उत् up, and डी to fly, Uṇādi affix श.
